111:t_1:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...I see. So it's finally happened...」

111:t_1:5.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Unfortunately, our current forces were not enough to stop the $$ネオ・ジオン$$ drop.」

111:t_1:6.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Captain $$オットー$$, what's the situation?」

111:t_1:7.en:
$$オットー$$
「A short while ago, we received word from Brigadier General $$カティ・マネキン$$.」

111:t_1:8.en:
$$オットー$$
「The $$ネオ・ジオン$$ units that dropped have taken $$ピーターソン$$ Base.」

111:t_1:9.en:
$$ブライト$$
「$$ピーターソン$$, huh...」

111:t_1:11.en:
$$ブライト$$
「It's not a large base, but the $$νガンダム$$ has been brought in there.」

111:t_1:13.en:
$$ブライト$$
「It was passed from one jurisdiction to the next, and we couldn't trace its whereabouts from our end either, but we finally got a lead the other day.」

111:t_1:14.en:
$$ブライト$$
「I sent Warrant Officer $$チェーン$$, and once the paperwork was finished, it was supposed to return to us. To think it would come to this...」

111:t_1:15.en:
$$オットー$$
「There's no way to put it but bad luck.」

111:t_1:17.en:
$$ブライト$$
「$$アムロ$$... Is something troubling you?」

111:t_1:18.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...No. Once we go to $$ピーターソン$$, the answer will be clear.」

111:t_1:19.en:
$$オットー$$
「You mean to retake that base?」

111:t_1:20.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「I agree as well. We should hit them before $$ネオ・ジオン$$ gets its posture in order, and at the same time probe their intentions.」

111:t_1:21.en:
$$オットー$$
「True, with every passing day we'd fall further behind the curve...」

111:t_1:22.en:
$$オットー$$
「Commander $$ブライト$$, we will head for $$ピーターソン$$ and retake the base from $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

111:t_1:23.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Understood. I'm counting on you, Captain $$オットー$$.」

111:t_1:24.en:
$$アムロ$$
($$ネオ・ジオン$$ and the $$νガンダム$$... If this is no coincidence, we'll need to be on guard...)

111:t_1:29.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...$$タクヤ$$. How's the maintenance on the $$リ・ガズィ$$?」

111:t_1:30.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「It's done. Crew Chief $$ジョナ$$ has finished the check as well.」

111:t_1:32.en:
$n
「Captain, you're going to retake the $$νガンダム$$ yourself?」

111:t_1:33.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...If I'm going to break through the enemy lines, the $$リ・ガズィ$$ is the best suited.」

111:t_1:34.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But going all by yourself...」

111:t_1:35.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I'll leave the backup to all of you. It makes me a failure as the mobile force's leader, though.」

111:t_1:36.en:
$n
「...It surprised me a little. That Captain $$アムロ$$ was so attached to the $$νガンダム$$...」

111:t_1:38.en:
$n
「Oh... sorry... It's just... I thought you were a lot more detached about mobile suits, Captain...」

111:t_1:39.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You're right, $n. A mobile suit is a weapon... a tool, so to speak. I don't intend to get more attached than necessary.」

111:t_1:40.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I'm going to get the $$νガンダム$$ only because I need a handy tool.」

111:t_1:41.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...That's what I would have answered before, but now it's a little different.」

111:t_1:42.en:
$n
「You mean you changed the way you think?」

111:t_1:43.en:
$$アムロ$$
「My view that mobile suits are tools hasn't changed...」

111:t_1:44.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But there's a theory that humanity evolved from earlier humans because they used tools and used fire.」

111:t_1:46.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Maybe humanity today is in that kind of transitional period, too.」

111:t_1:47.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Are you saying tools... that mobile suits make people evolve?」

111:t_1:48.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...The $$Ｚガンダム$$, which turns people's will into power. The $$ダブルオーライザー$$, which uses the $$ＧＮドライヴ$$ to urge an awakening into $$イノベイター$$s...」

111:t_1:49.en:
$$アムロ$$
「And your $$ユニコーン$$, too... If you look at machines like these, you start to feel that way.」

111:t_1:52.en:
$$アムロ$$
「It's just my fantasy. Don't think too hard about it.」

111:t_1:53.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But that day, in the glow of the $$時空修復|lc$$, I saw a light in the $$νガンダム$$.」

111:t_1:54.en:
$$アムロ$$
「To find out what it was, I intend to ride that machine again.」

111:t_1:55.en:
$n
「Understood, Captain. I'll back you up with everything I've got.」

111:t_1:56.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「$n, were you convinced by Captain $$アムロ$$'s explanation?」

111:t_1:57.en:
$n
「You saw the light during the $$時空修復|lc$$ too, didn't you?」

111:t_1:59.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I think that was a power that changes things. I want to believe in it, too.」

111:t_1:60.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Thanks, $$バナージ$$. And you too, $n.」

111:t_1:61.en:
$n
「N-no... I'm sorry for saying something rude earlier.」

111:t_1:62.en:
$$アムロ$$
「It's fine. ...I understand why you said it, too.」

111:t_1:64.en:
$$アムロ$$
「It's the same as my betting on the $$νガンダム$$. Come to terms with the $$スフィア$$ inside you.」

111:t_1:68.en:
$$アムロ$$
(That's right, $n. There must be something beyond fear and anxiety, anger, hatred and sorrow...)

111:t_1:74.en:
$$ネオ・ジオン兵$$
「So this is the Gundam that stood at the center of the phenomenon that stopped $$アクシズ$$ from falling...」

111:t_1:75.en:
$$ネオ・ジオン兵$$
「Damn thing... If it weren't for this machine, the world the Colonel is leading us to would have been completed.」

111:t_1:77.en:
$$ネオ・ジオン兵$$
「Let's use it as an aggressor and shoot it down in a big show, as an object lesson.」

111:t_1:78.en:
$$ネオ・ジオン兵$$
「Refitting it with a Zeon-style design to hunt down the Federation remnants wouldn't be bad either.」

111:t_1:79.en:
$$チェーン$$
「Are you people... fighting over personal grudges?」

111:t_1:80.en:
$$ネオ・ジオン兵$$
「Looks like you don't understand your position.」

111:t_1:81.en:
$$ネオ・ジオン兵$$
「You have no freedom. The only reason we haven't locked you up is that you're a technical officer.」

111:t_1:82.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I won't allow anyone to lay a hand on a prisoner.」

111:t_1:85.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Command of this unit, including what becomes of this Gundam, has been left entirely to me.」

111:t_1:86.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「You men, fall back. That's an order.」

111:t_1:87.en:
$$ネオ・ジオン兵$$
「Farce or not, I think highly of the Captain's skill in taking a Federation base.」

111:t_1:88.en:
$$ネオ・ジオン兵$$
「I look forward to seeing your handiwork, Captain $$ギュネイ$$.」

ピーターソン.evidence: Peterson Base: Federation base in North America where the Nu Gundam was shipped (cf. Peterson Air Force Base, Colorado). Used as `$$ピーターソン$$ Base` for ピーターソン基地; bare ピーターソン = `$$ピーターソン$$`.

ジョナ.evidence: ジョナ機付長: crew chief who checked the Re-GZ; not in the sheet; gender unknown. Rendered `Crew Chief $$ジョナ$$`.

111:t_1:14: 准尉 = Warrant Officer (Chan); subject of 復帰 is the Nu Gundam

111:t_1:75: 大佐 = 'the Colonel' (Char), as in other slices
